contents_summary: One-page PDF with a STRING protein-protein interaction network of SOX11 and ten high-myopia-related proteins and its caption; bioinformatic analysis, no patient data.

pages.contents: One portrait page. A network diagram of eleven circular protein nodes (SOX11, COL11A1, COL2A1, COL9A1, SOX4, P4HA2, P3H2, FGFR3, COL18A1, ERBB3, ASXL1) joined by multicolored lines, with an evidence-type color legend beneath (curated databases, gene neighborhood, gene co-occurrence, co-expression, experimentally determined, gene fusions, textmining, protein homology), then a printed caption.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Computational protein-interaction analysis described in the article discussion; no individual patient measurements.
